'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[2025 Goma offensive]]
****The [[United Nations]] and the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] [[Ministry of Transport and Channels of Communication|communications minister]] [[Patrick Muyaya]] recognize that most of the 165 female prisoners of the [[Goma]] prison in [[North Kivu]] who were raped by escaping male inmates a week ago died in the ensuing fire. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/06/africa/female-inmates-raped-killed-goma-jailbreak-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/feb/05/democratic-republic-congo-goma-women-raped-burned-death-prison-m23-rebels-rwanda (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Toretsk]]
***[[Russia]] says [[Russian Armed Forces|its forces]] have taken full control of [[Toretsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], after months of [[urban warfare]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-it-has-taken-control-city-toretsk-eastern-ukraine-2025-02-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Twenty-five civilians are killed after an [[ambush]] by [[Islamic State – Sahel Province|Islamic State]] gunmen against a convoy of buses in [[Gao]], [[Mali]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-convoy-attack-junta-4abef9871d0103c1df1fd5961bfce157 (AP)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**The [[Somali National Army]], supported by local Ma'awisley clan [[militia]]s, kills dozens of [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] insurgents during heavy clashes which erupted after allied forces launch an offensive targeting al-Shabaab stronghold positions in the Jicibow area of [[Shebelle River]], [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiiraan]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200155/several_al_shabaab_militants_killed_in_fighting_in_hiiraan_region.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Bering Air Flight 445]]
**The wreckage of the [[Bering Air]] [[Cessna 208B Grand Caravan]] that went missing while flying over the [[Norton Sound]] in [[Alaska]], [[United States]], yesterday is found crashed {{conv|34|mi|km}} from [[Nome, Alaska|Nome]] with no survivors. [https://www.voanews.com/a/wreckage-of-missing-alaska-plane-found-no-survivors/7967549.html (VOA)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-02-08/alaska-plane-missing-found/104913406 (ABC News Australia)]
*Four people are killed in a firecracker explosion in [[Kalyani, West Bengal|Kalyani]], [[West Bengal]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/kolkata/explosion-at-firecracker-factory-west-bengal-nadia-death-toll-9823113/?ref=archive_pg (The Indian Express)]
*A [[Beechcraft King Air|Beechcraft King Air F90]] crashes in [[Barra Funda (district of São Paulo)|Barra Funda]], [[São Paulo]], [[Brazil]], killing the two people on board and wounding six on the ground. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/07/americas/brazil-sao-paulo-plane-crash-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*Two tourists die in [[Colombo]], [[Sri Lanka]], when their hostel room is [[fumigation|fumigated]] with a [[pesticide]] for [[bedbug]]s. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/07/asia/tourists-sri-lanka-bedbugs-deaths-scli-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2025 H5N1 outbreak]]
**[[Government of New York City|Officials]] in [[New York City]], [[United States]], order the closure of all [[wet market|live]] [[poultry farming|poultry markets]] in the city as well as in the surrounding suburban counties of [[Westchester County, New York|Westchester]], [[Suffolk County, New York|Suffolk]], and [[Nassau County, New York|Nassau]] due to an increase in cases of [[H5N1|avian influenza]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/new-york-city-shuts-live-poultry-markets-over-bird-flu-cases/a-71330201 (DW)]
**The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] reports that [[influenza]] in the United States is at its highest peak since the [[2009 swine flu pandemic|2009 swine flu]] [[pandemic]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/flu-levels-highest-since-2009-pandemic-cdc-reports/ (CBS News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[South Africa–United States relations]], [[Racism in South Africa]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] orders a freeze on all [[Aid|foreign aid]] to [[South Africa]] citing a South African [[Land reform in South Africa|law]] that allegedly allows land to be forcibly seized from white farmers. Trump also calls for the U.S. to accept [[Afrikaners|Afrikaner]] refugees to protect them from "government-sponsored race-based discrimination". [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/donald-trump-freezes-aid-to-south-africa-citing-law-to-seize-land-7660730 (NDTV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A person is killed as a fourth shooting takes place in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]], within a few days. The murder is related to the other three non-fatal shootings. As a result, the six separate [[Law enforcement in Belgium|police]] [[police precinct|zones]] in Brussels will start working under one command. [https://apnews.com/article/belgium-shootings-gangland-cocaine-f998f37d7fa50e8a554b2c6afbc4d0c9 (AP)]
*Seventy-nine countries jointly speak out in a statement against the [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] imposed by [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] on the [[International Criminal Court]] officials. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2554918-79-landen-veroordelen-amerikaanse-sancties-tegen-internationaal-strafhof (NOS)]
*[[Germany|German]] [[Federal Police (Germany)|Federal Police]] detains 16 [[India]]n nationals found in a van in [[Aachen]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], including 15 passengers and the driver, as they attempt to enter the country without valid documents. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-16-indians-stopped-in-migrant-smuggling-attempt/a-71536771 (DW)]
*Three people, including the perpetrator, are killed and three others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] [[familicide]] when a military police officer opens fire at a house in [[Prey Ampok Commune]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/501636310/military-police-officer-shoots-2-dead-injures-3-before-killing-himself/ (Khmer Times)]
